sources.snippet: Official implementation of POLARNet, a generative portrait relighting framework built on the POLAR OLAT representation. POLARNet predicts direction-aware OLAT lighting responses from a portrait image and enables realistic portrait relighting under novel illumination. sources.title: LoRA (machine learning) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique for large language models and other deep neural networks. Introduced in 2021 by researchers at Microsoft, LoRA enables adaptation of pre-trained models to specific tasks while requiring significantly fewer computational resources and trainable parameters than traditional ...
